Author: @ZeroX252
Content:
Real talk:

This is a market space that is developing. It's niche, but its there. I think the pelican case itself is a great form factor for it, too. Better utilization of the internal space and better engineering for the component layout and portable private network infrastructure for events makes a lot of sense. Event spaces already have stuff for things like this but its usually just the networking side and it's not private to you. The venue usually has like a audio rack on wheels that has some switches in it or whatever you can use to network a bunch of devices but that's not what this is for this is for keeping the event's private data private. You guys built something similar-ish for recording and editing abroad.

I wouldn't mind having a pelican case I could toss in my car when I travel that has a decent size storage server, gaming rig, and some network infrastructure for me to have a more comfortable time computing locally while at events and working abroad than I do with say, my laptop and an external monitor.

Content: Why only use one port on the HBA?  The IOM will accept two connections to the HBA to double the bandwidth.  I'm running my DS4243 with IOM6s and DS2246 with two connections each. I honestly only really need 4 ports for my HDDs currently but 24 of those drives would likely benefit from 8 ports.
